stage0055_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Soon the advance unit will engage the defenders.
　I'll continue commanding our forces and
　secure Fifth Luna.」

stage0055_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$シャア$$
「Hurry, $$フル・フロンタル$$.
　$c is heading this way too.」

stage0055_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Understood.
　I'll bring down Fifth before they arrive.」

stage0055_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「They've scattered their forces for now.
　If they try anything, I'll turn it
　right back on them.」

stage0055_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$シャア$$
「Don't push yourself.
　Depending on the situation, I may sortie too.」

stage0055_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That won't be necessary, Supreme Commander.
　Now, please await good news.」

stage0055_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「You seem unhappy with this operation?」

stage0055_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$シャア$$
「Strategically, $$フロンタル$$'s proposal is sound.
　That's why I approved it.」

stage0055_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「But going through with it breaks the treaty...
　And that's bound to hurt us after the war.
　That worries you too, doesn't it?」

stage0055_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's assuming there is an after the war.」

stage0055_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$, is it...」

stage0055_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's one reason I approved $$フロンタル$$'s plan.
　I also want to confirm what physical energy
　does to a $$時空震動$$.」

stage0055_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That reminds me, when 《$$大時空震動$$》 hit,
　you were at $$ユニウスセブン$$, the future singularity...」

stage0055_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right.
　This operation is also meant to recreate
　those conditions, to find a clue to $$時空震動$$.」

stage0055_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$シャア$$
「If the terror of a worldwide catastrophe
　overlaps with the $$次元力|lc$$ Earth draws out,
　it might trigger a $$時空震動$$.」

stage0055_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$シャア$$
（I doubt they'd ever approve of a method like that...）

stage0055_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you've convinced yourself, don't let it show.
　It unsettles the troops.」

stage0055_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$シャア$$
「...True enough.
　I appreciate the advice, $$ハマーン$$.」

stage0055_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Able to thank someone honestly now. You've grown.」

stage0055_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$シャア$$
「Where do you intend to go?」

stage0055_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I left command of this operation to $$フロンタル$$.
　I'll move as I please.」

stage0055_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$シャア$$
（...It's you who won't accept $$フロンタル$$, $$ハマーン$$.）

stage0055_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$シャア$$
（But humanity has reached a point where
　we must set feelings aside.）

stage0055_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$シャア$$
（Do you understand, $$アムロ$$...?
　This impatience I feel...）

stage0055_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That man... will $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　really show up?」

stage0055_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If he won't show, I'll drag him out.」

stage0055_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you going to settle this for good?」

stage0055_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe it's because of what $$ゼロ$$ said...
　My resolve is wavering.」

stage0055_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アムロ$$
「And here I told you and $$バナージ$$ to push
　past your doubts. Pathetic of me.」

stage0055_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Can you fight like that?」

stage0055_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll manage.
　Stopping him is my job.」

stage0055_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But right now, I want to confirm his true
　intent more than fight him. That's why I sortie.」

stage0055_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Understood, Captain.
　...I feel the same way.」

stage0055_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「No... it's not just me.
　$$シン$$, $$キラ$$, $$アルト$$ and the others too.」

stage0055_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「When $$シャア・アズナブル$$ shows up, leave
　the surrounding enemies to us. Captain $$アムロ$$,
　please go straight for him.」

stage0055_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Sorry.
　I'll count on you here.」

stage0055_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「His true intent... I'll find it out, I swear.」

stage0055_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「N, Neo Zeon is boarding us!?」

stage0055_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「$$タクヤ$$!
　Take $$ミコット$$ and $$オードリー$$ and evacuate!」

stage0055_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Damn it! They've broken through!」

stage0055_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（I can feel it...
　She's here, without question...）

stage0055_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$!?」

stage0055_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$オードリー$$
（You've come to take me back, haven't you.
　But...）

stage0055_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$ガランシェール$$ squad, fall back.」

stage0055_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Any further is too dangerous.
　Seeing her safe is enough for today.」

stage0055_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Push Neo Zeon back!
　No need to chase them far!
　First, secure the ship's safety!!」

stage0055_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「No way...
　$$ハマーン・カーン$$ boarding us herself for melee...」

stage0055_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ミコット$$
「But she left without doing much of anything...」

stage0055_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$オードリー$$
（$$ハマーン$$...
　I believe you'll understand what I intend...）

stage0055_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text: ～ $$ラー・カイラム$$ $$アムロ$$'s Quarters ～

stage0055_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Thanks, $$ベルトーチカ$$.
　Impressive, getting hold of the $$νガンダム$$.」

stage0055_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「$$カラバ$$, Luio & Co., and old $$エゥーゴ$$
　contacts, all mobilized. That's the result.」

stage0055_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「Though in the end, some unknown power
　seems to have broken the seal for us.」

stage0055_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Neo Zeon's... or $$シャア$$'s doing?」

stage0055_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「Not that.
　After the Zeta incident, we've kept
　an eye on that line ourselves.」

stage0055_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$アムロ$$
（The Newtype-use Gundam was sealed away
　by people at Anaheim in league with
　Earth supremacists...）

stage0055_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アムロ$$
（If not $$シャア$$, then who moved?
　Is there someone with power to match the Earth
　supremacists tightening their grip on the Federation...?）

stage0055_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Stopping $$シャア$$ matters more right now.
　I'll use whatever helps toward that.」

stage0055_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「I'll look into how the $$νガンダム$$'s seal
　was broken from our end too.」

stage0055_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「But be careful, $$アムロ$$.
　Neo Zeon isn't $c's only enemy.」

stage0055_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The Earth supremacists within the Federation...」

stage0055_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「They don't acknowledge Newtypes exist.
　So they conspired with Anaheim to seal
　Gundams, and had a unit called Unicorn made.」

stage0055_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$c must be a mixed blessing for them.
　The Newtypes they despise are busy
　killing each other with Neo Zeon.」

stage0055_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I can understand a little of how $$シャア$$
　feels, fighting a war against them.」

stage0055_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「...Should I join $c too?」

stage0055_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You've got your own job to do.
　I appreciate you worrying about me,
　but you don't need to match my pace.」

stage0055_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「Understood.
　But don't let your guard down around $$チェーン$$.」

stage0055_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Why does she come up now...!?」

stage0055_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「Heh... even I can get intel like that.
　I know she's quite the charmer, too.」

stage0055_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「See you, $$アムロ$$...
　I love you.」

stage0055_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$チェーン$$
「What's wrong, you seem flustered...?
　I can come back later if this is a bad time.」

stage0055_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アムロ$$
「No, it's fine.
　I'm the one who called you here.」

stage0055_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$チェーン$$
「About the $$νガンダム$$, it seems $$アルベルト$$
　still has no intention of explaining.」

stage0055_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「He's never been a good liar.
　Maybe he really doesn't know.」

stage0055_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Let's have $$ベルトーチカ$$
　continue looking into that.」

stage0055_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Yes...
　I was tracking down the $$νガンダム$$ myself,
　so we exchanged information.」

stage0055_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$チェーン$$
「She's a very active, coquettish person.」

stage0055_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Guess the men are the last to know...」

stage0055_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$チェーン$$
「But right now, I'm the one by your side, Captain.」

stage0055_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$チェーン$$
「...I'm sorry.
　You're not in the mood for that right now, are you.」

stage0055_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$アムロ$$
「There's no need to worry about $$シャア$$.
　I managed to find my own closure.」

stage0055_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Does that mean you understand him?」

stage0055_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Understanding each other doesn't mean
　you don't have to fight...」

stage0055_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I felt his resolve firsthand, but
　I still can't understand his intent.」

stage0055_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Much less do I approve of his methods.」

stage0055_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Shouldering everything alone is his bad habit.
　And this time, he's gone too far chasing ideals.」

stage0055_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The soldiers swept up in it, and the
　world dragged along, are the real victims.」

stage0055_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Those who support him
　seem to sense charisma in that.」

stage0055_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's merely serving as an outlet
　for Spacenoid discontent.」

stage0055_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「What $$シャア$$ thinks... his ideals, his beliefs,
　not every soldier can truly understand them.
　They're just dragged into an intellectual's revolt.」

stage0055_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$チェーン$$
「So the war goes on...」

stage0055_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Belatedly, I've managed to steel my resolve too.
　...Maybe that's why $$シャア$$
　showed himself before us...」

stage0055_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Forget it.
　Thinking everything's going his way
　doesn't sit well with me.」

stage0055_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$チェーン$$
「$c will
　keep pressuring Neo Zeon for now, but
　will make port at the Frontier fleet to resupply.」

stage0055_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$チェーン$$
「They're in the briefing room,
　talking about today's battle.」

stage0055_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$チェーン$$
「As expected, the plan to drop Fifth Luna
　seems to have hit them hard.」

stage0055_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Then I suppose I'll light a fire under them.」

stage0055_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$チェーン$$
「That's not like you, Captain...」

stage0055_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If $$シャア$$ can play the adult, I won't lose to him.
　I don't intend to stay a naive kid forever either.」

stage0055_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$アムロ$$
（That's right... I have to settle this.
　He and I, in the past...）

stage0055_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A Federation fleet is stationed at Fifth Luna.
　A second invasion won't come easily.」

stage0055_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$シャア$$
「Even so, it had the effect of
　scattering the enemy's main force.」

stage0055_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Are you giving up on the operation, Commander?」

stage0055_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$シャア$$
「Dropping Fifth Luna on Tibet...
　It would certainly make quite an impact.」

stage0055_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$シャア$$
「But given how great the drawbacks are,
　clinging to it would be dangerous.」

stage0055_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even if it is the right thing to do?」

stage0055_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$シャア$$
「Right...?
　An odd choice of words.」

stage0055_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Forgive me.
　It seems I chose my words poorly.」

stage0055_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「How is Her Excellency $$ハマーン$$ doing?
　I hear she failed to reclaim Lady $$ミネバ$$.」

stage0055_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$シャア$$
「She doesn't seem particularly shocked.
　She says as long as she's safe, and no one's
　found out she's the Zeon princess, that's enough.」

stage0055_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's rather comical that the Spacenoids
　who buried the old god now enshrine the Zabi family.」

stage0055_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「With a Commander already in place,
　she no longer holds any meaning as a symbol.」

stage0055_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$シャア$$
「True.
　But there's no shortage of people who'd use her.」

stage0055_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Do you mean to protect the Zabi heir?」

stage0055_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$シャア$$
「...I gave up on personal grudges long ago.」

stage0055_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Understood.
　But we have no time left to spare.」

stage0055_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Less than three months remain
　until $$エタニティ・フラット$$.」

stage0055_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$シャア$$
「I don't recall telling you about that...」

stage0055_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have my own sources of information, too.」

stage0055_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$シャア$$
「Not a word of this to anyone, $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

stage0055_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Understood.
　Then I'll proceed with handling $c.」

stage0055_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll settle things with $$アムロ・レイ$$
　and show you the result myself.」

stage0055_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$シャア$$
「It's a strange feeling.
　A man who looks like me, sounds like me,
　speaking $$アムロ$$'s name...」

stage0055_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$シャア$$
「There's something I want kept confidential.」

stage0055_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$シャア$$
「Gather all the information you can
　on $$フル・フロンタル$$'s true identity.」

stage0055_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「Understood.
　I'll do my best to meet your expectations, Colonel.」

stage0055_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$シャア$$
「Same face, same voice, same abilities,
　even the same memories...」

stage0055_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$シャア$$
「Don't tell me he and I...」

stage0055_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$シャア$$
「This vision again...
　Why do I keep seeing this...?」

stage0055_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$シャア$$
「A shining cosmos...
　Is this... the sight of the world's end...?」

stage0055_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I was thinking about that person,
　$$フル・フロンタル$$.」

stage0055_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「He's $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s body double, sure,
　but to me, he seems even more dangerous
　than the real $$シャア$$.」

stage0055_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Reading the Red Comet's biography I
　borrowed from $$タクヤ$$, $$シャア$$ is described as
　cold, calculating, a composed, capable soldier...」

stage0055_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Comparing Captain $$クワトロ$$, as $$カミーユ$$
　and the others describe him, to the $$フル・フロンタル$$
　I met, he's closer to the image of $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0055_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A body double more genuine than the real thing.
　How very intriguing...」

stage0055_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But wasn't it $c
　who drove that $$フル・フロンタル$$ off?」

stage0055_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Everyone's high spirits back then
　produced 100 Z worth of Z-Chips.
　I'll add these to the squad's stock.」

stage0055_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I wonder if we'll fight that person again...」

stage0055_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Most likely...
　$$フル・フロンタル$$ seems interested
　in your Unicorn, Master $$バナージ$$.」

stage0055_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Count on you again next time, Master $$バナージ$$.
　I hope you'll produce more Z-Chips.」

stage0055_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let me teach you, wavering Master $$バナージ$$,
　an easy way to tell $$フル・フロンタル$$
　apart from $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0055_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A soldier with sleeves is $$フル・フロンタル$$,
　a uniform without is Captain $$クワトロ$$, $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0055_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Sleeves means $$フル・フロンタル$$,
　no sleeves means $$シャア・アズナブル$$.
　You won't mix them up now.」

stage0055_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What kind of a rule is that...」

stage0055_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$タクヤ$$, Master $$ミコット$$... I'm relieved
　to see you both unharmed.」

stage0055_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Still, that was a shock.
　$$ハマーン・カーン$$ boarding the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$
　out of nowhere like that.」

stage0055_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How was Master $$ハマーン$$ in the flesh?」

stage0055_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ミコット$$
「What, $$ＡＧ$$...
　You use 'Master' even for the enemy?」

stage0055_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no...
　It's more like a Neo Zeon custom.」

stage0055_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That woman is wildly popular
　among Neo Zeon's younger set, and that's
　apparently what they call her.」

stage0055_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Well... beautiful, sure, but
　she really was as scary as they say,
　living up to being called the Iron Lady.」

stage0055_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「I'm sure that was a shock for $$オードリー$$ too.
　The enemy just appearing right in front of her.」

stage0055_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ミコット$$
「But those Neo Zeon people...
　what were they even here for, boarding this ship?」

stage0055_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「True enough.
　And they left again right away...」

stage0055_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$オードリー$$
（$$ハマーン$$... she understood my feelings...
　Can I live up to that...）

stage0055_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, Master $$オードリー$$.
　No matter how shocking something is,
　people have to keep on living.」

stage0055_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Worrying matters too, but first you must act.
　That's how people move forward.」

stage0055_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「So how exactly does a robot move forward?」

stage0055_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally, fulfilling your given mission comes first.」

stage0055_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That being the case,
　let's get fired up today too... business, business!」
